title: ActionIntentToken
description: Cryptographically signed, single-use, nonce-bound mutation intent emitted by the Governed Action Intent Hub (Constitution Principle II).

intent_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying this action proposal.

parameters.description: Action type specific payload, validated against the Action Type schema.

evidence_refs.description: Array of entity IDs or trace evidence references justifying the action.

severity.description: HIGH severity requires four-eyes approval (2 distinct approvers).

nonce.description: Cryptographically secure 128-bit hex nonce preventing replay attacks.

requester_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that proposed the action.

kms_key_id.description: Resource identifier of the Cloud KMS ECDSA P-256 key version used for signing.

signature.description: Base64-encoded ASN.1 DER ECDSA P-256 signature over the canonical JSON payload.
